claim: One deterministic Burn run reproducing delayed generalization from random initialization, followed by learned Fourier analysis; not exact weights, transition epochs, or seed robustness.

initialization.trainable: all learned parameters including both MLP biases
initialization.random_generator_note: Burn seed fixes this run; no claim of byte-identical PyTorch initialization. Author Config.seed controls Python split; pinned trainer contains no torch.manual_seed call.

data.split_generator: CPython 3.11.9 random.Random(0).shuffle on lexicographic pair indices
data.label: (a + b) % 113
data.test_indices: ascending complement of committed training indices
data.batch: entire training split every optimizer update

optimizer.parameter_groups: one group; weight decay on all trainable parameters
optimizer.warmup: update index u is zero-based: learning_rate(u) = 0.001 * min(u / 10, 1); u=0 updates moments with zero learning rate

precision.training_loss: differentiable stabilized cross entropy on all 114 output classes
precision.reported_cross_entropy: float64 analysis of saved float32 logits
precision.note: Notebook cell26 uses float64 log_softmax; pinned helpers.py instead uses float32 despite its comment. Burn numerical operations and initialization are a disclosed implementation adaptation.

measurement.evaluation: all 3830 train and all 8939 test pairs; no held-out optimization
measurement.post_training_frequency_selection: Apply the same pair-power definition to W_mlp_out @ W_unembed[:,0..113], sum across MLP neurons, choose the five greatest pair powers; ties resolve toward smaller k. Use these learned frequencies in final intervention analysis, never the archived seed-zero frequency list.
controls: fresh random initialization, no pretrained checkpoint
measurement.fourier_power_definition: For k=1..56, use real orthonormal cosine/sine vectors over classes 0..112 (sqrt(2/113) normalization). Pair power is squared cosine coefficient plus squared sine coefficient, summed over the other tensor axis. Normalize pair powers by their sum over k=1..56; exclude the DC component and equals-token class.

acceptance.criterion: There exists a recorded update with train accuracy > 0.99 and test accuracy < 0.50, followed by a strictly later recorded update with test accuracy > 0.99.
acceptance.final_model_claim: Report actual final metrics, transition interval at measurement resolution, and Fourier analysis, including failures.
not_claimed: exact Table 1 numerical values from a newly initialized model

allowed_pre_run_engineering.backend: Benchmark ten updates with Flex and an available Burn GPU backend; choose execution backend for runtime while keeping this mathematical protocol. Benchmark states are discarded and the measured run starts fresh.
allowed_pre_run_engineering.amendments: Record protocol revision and reason before any changed run; retain unsuccessful runs. Do not tune success thresholds after observing outcomes.
